package main

func choose(a, b chan int) int {
	select {
	case v := <-a:
		return v
	case v := <-b:
		return v
	}
}

func chooseOther(a, b chan int) int {
	select {
	case v := <-a:
		return v
	case v := <-b:
		return v
	}
}

//go:noinline
func positive(a, b chan int) int {
	return choose(a, b)
}

//go:noinline
func conflicting(a, b chan int) int {
	first := choose(a, b)
	return first + chooseOther(a, b)
}

//go:noinline
func sameChain(a, b chan int) int {
	first := choose(a, b)
	return first + choose(a, b)
}

//go:noinline
func known(a, b chan int) int {
	select {
	case v := <-a:
		return v
	case v := <-b:
		return v
	}
}

var indirect = known

//go:noinline
func unknown(a, b chan int) int {
	first := choose(a, b)
	return first + indirect(a, b)
}

func main() {
	a, b := make(chan int, 16), make(chan int, 16)
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		a <- i
		b <- i
	}
	result := positive(a, b) + conflicting(a, b) + sameChain(a, b) + known(a, b) + unknown(a, b)
	println("symbolize", result)
}
